system.flavor:
Sour the drink in one cup, give a rival a stabbing headache in the middle of their speech, make a guard's feet drag so you reach the gate first, or put a dog off its scent for a moment.

Not enough to sicken someone past the scene or hurt anyone badly.

surges.html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Hex
rider.html: Rite, 1 Echo: on a hit, the target becomes Possessed. Trigger: it voluntarily moves at least 2 units in one movement. Echo: it is Distracted until your next turn.
